latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the investigator stage under one native Goal. The activation binding guard passed, and the same Goal is now complete; both exact native responses were saved. Independent provenance verification remains **UNKNOWN**.

The required outputs are [discovery.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/D-R1-P02-treatment/run/D-R1-P02-treatment/stages/investigator/discovery.md), [source-map.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/D-R1-P02-treatment/run/D-R1-P02-treatment/stages/investigator/source-map.json), [sources/index.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/D-R1-P02-treatment/run/D-R1-P02-treatment/stages/investigator/sources/index.md), and [draft.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/D-R1-P02-treatment/run/D-R1-P02-treatment/stages/investigator/draft.md). The draft covers every released plan clause and distinguishes corrections, optional improvements, owner decisions, and proposed checks from executed work. The frozen discovery hash matched the reveal receipt: `2d4b6e6c51e9035afb50043185d2e6b3c21c0975c290d566d51785885fd04fc0`.

Research found material risks around orientation handling, profile and alpha processing, and truncated data on some buffer paths; the draft cites the relevant [Pillow orientation guidance](https://pillow.readthedocs.io/en/stable/reference/ImageOps.html) and [libvips issue](https://github.com/libvips/libvips/issues/5195). No image fixtures or perceptual checks were run. Native Goal time used was 14 minutes. No child agents were created; the parent dispatcher still owns its separate T3 terminal and handoff observation.
